title: Обзор автоматизации
description: Что приводит к росту необходимости автоматизировать повседневные операции?

produces.objective: Classify everyday scenarios as automation or not, using the definition of automation as a self-driven process that reduces and removes the need for human intervention.

measurement.passes_when: All embedded questions answered correctly (100%, unlimited attempts): automation versus manual control in everyday scenarios.
